2608.11660.title: Hybrid-Policy Self-Editing for Composable Unstructured Knowledge Editing
2608.11660.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve remarkable performance across natural language tasks, yet they are trained on static corpora and their knowledge quickly becomes outdated in a fast-changing world. This motivates knowledge editing (KE), which updates specific knowledge in an LLM without changing unrelated others. Recent works move from structured knowledge triples toward unstructured KE (UKE), where the edit is a free-form passage that may state multiple facts at once. Nonetheless, existing editors inject such a passage yet fail to use it: the edited model can recall the passage, but can neither answer atomic questions about its facts nor compose them into multi-hop reasoning. We attribute this missing property, which we term composability, to editors' passive reliance on the fixed passage as the sole learning source. In response, we cast editing as a proactive self-distillation from a privileged in-context state of the same model, which requires no external supervision. We further reveal that due to the novelty of the injected knowledge, the pre-edited model's own rollouts rarely cover it, which limits the effectiveness of pure on-policy distillation. To close this gap, we propose HPSE, which builds a hybrid rollout that steps in to place missing facts onto the student's own trajectory precisely where its coverage fails, while staying on-policy elsewhere. We theoretically analyze HPSE's advantage over pure on-policy distillation, and empirically establish its plug-and-play improvements across four LLM backbones and two KE editors under various scenarios.
2608.11660.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在自然語言任務中表現卓越，但它們是在靜態語料庫上訓練的，且在快速變化的世界中，其知識迅速過時。這促使了知識編輯（KE）的出現，它可以在不改變無關知識的情況下更新LLM中的特定知識。近期的研究從結構化知識三元組轉向非結構化知識編輯（UKE），在這種情況下，編輯是一段自由形式的文本，可能同時陳述多個事實。然而，現有的編輯器雖然可以注入這樣的文本，但卻未能有效使用它：編輯後的模型可以回憶起這段文本，但無法回答關於其事實的原子問題，也無法將其組合成多跳推理。我們將這一缺失的屬性稱為可組合性，並歸因於編輯器對固定文本的被動依賴，將其視為唯一的學習來源。為此，我們將編輯視為從同一模型的特權上下文狀態進行主動自我蒸餾，這不需要外部監督。我們進一步揭示，由於注入知識的新穎性，編輯前模型的自身展開很少涵蓋這些知識，這限制了純在政策蒸餾的有效性。為了填補這一空白，我們提出了HPSE，它構建了一種混合展開，精確地在學生自身的軌跡上插入缺失的事實，正是在其覆蓋失敗的地方，同時在其他地方保持在政策內。我們理論上分析了HPSE相對於純在政策蒸餾的優勢，並在各種情境下實證建立了其在四個LLM骨幹和兩個KE編輯器上的即插即用改進。
